paite: Unaute aw, hiaite na theih louh uh ka deih kei, huchi a i pipute tengteng meipi nuai a a-om vek ua, avek ua tuipi leng akan ua,
heading: Israelte Tanchin A Pan Sinsakna

paite: avek ua meipi leh tuipi a Mosi a baptis lut a a-om vek ua,
avek ua khalam an kibang anek chiat ua,
avek ua khalam dawn ding kibang adawn chiatdan uh. Amaute zui, khalam Suangpi a pan adawn chiat ngal ua; huai Suangpi Khrist ahi.
Himahleh alak ua mi tamzaw tung ah Pathian alunghita kei a; gamdai ah apuklum uhi.
Huan huai thilte ei ding a etton ding ahi, thil gilou alunggulh bang ua i lunggulh samlouhna ding in.
Alak ua khenkhat milim bemi ahih bang un milim bemi hi kei un, "Mipite ne ding leh dawn ding in atu ua, lam ding in adingh nawn chiat uh," chih gelh bang in.
Alak ua khenkhat in nungak angai ua, ni khat in singnih-le-sangthum in apuklup loh bang un, i kingai kei ding uh.
Alak ua khenkhat in Toupa aze-et ua, gul a hihman a a-om bang un, Toupa zaw i ze-et kei ding uh.
Alak ua khenkhat aphun ua, hihmangthangpa hihmanthat a a-om bang un, phun sam kei ni.
Huan huaite vaukholhna ding in atung uah ahong tung hi; eite, hun tawp hong tunnate, hon thuhilhna ding a leng gelh ahi uhi.
Huaiziak in dingh a kingaihtuah pilvang hen, huchi lou in zaw apuk kha ding hi.

Mihing thuak theih val khemna himhim na tuang uah atung ngei kei hi. Pathian zaw amuanhuai hi, ama'n na thuak theih val uh khemna na tuah uh aphal kei ding; na thuaktheihna ding un khemna peuh ah taikhiakna lampi abawl zaw ding hi.
Huaiziak in ka deihtakte aw, milim biak taisan un.
heading: Milim Biak Taisan Un

paite: Mipilte kiang a gen bang in ka thugente ngaihtuah un.
Vualzawlna nou a ka hon vualzawl uh, Khrist sisan kikoppihna ahi kei a hia? Tanghou ka balkhap uh Khrist pumpi kikoppihna ahi kei a hia?
Eite mi tampi tanghou beu khat, pum khat i hi uh; i vek un tanghou beu khat ah i tang chiat uhi.
Salam a Israelte en dih ua; kithoihna sa nete'n maitam thilte akikoppih kei ua hia?
Bang ka genna ahia le? Milim lak a kithoihna leh milim leng banghiamtak ahi chih ka genna hia?
Zentelte kithoihna, Pathian lak ah hilou in dawite lak ah akithoih uh ahi chih ka gen zaw ahi; noute zaw dawite toh na kithuah uh hon deih lou ka hi.
Toupa nou leh dawi nou na dawnkhawm thei kei ding uh; Toupa dohkan leh dawi dohkan ah na nekhawm thei sam kei ding uh.
Ahihkeileh Toupa hazatna tohthoh i tum uh ahi maw? Amah sang in i hatzaw ua hia?
"Thil bangkim hih asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih ahoih kei, "Thil bangkim hih asiang a," himahleh thil bangkim hih in mi abawlhoih kei hi.
heading: Khristian Noplenna Zatdik

paite: Kuapeuh in amah hoihna ding zong lou in midang hoihna ding zong zaw hen.
Sa dawr a azuak peuhmah uh na sia-le-pha theihna ziak un bangmah dong lou in ne un.
"Lei leh asung a tengteng Toupa a ahi ngal a."
Gingloumi lak a kuahiam in nou hon sap a, hoh na ut ngal un, sia-le-pha theihna ziak in bangmah dong lou in, ahon lui peuh uh ne un.
Himahleh kuahiam in, "Hiai zaw kithoihna ahi chi a ahon hilh leh sia-le-pha theihna ziak leh nou a hon hilhpa ziak in ne kei un,"
Nangmah sia-le-pha theihna ka chi kei a, ama sia-le-pha theihna pen ahi ka chih zawk. Bang achia midang sia-le-pha theihna in ka noplenna thunun ahia?
Kipaktak a ka tanleh atung a kipahthu ka genna tung ah bang ding a gensiat a om ka hia?
Huchi in na nek uhiam na dawn uhiam, na hih peuhmah uh, Pathian thupina ding ngen in hih un.
Judate a ding hiam, Grikte a ding hiam, Pathian saptuamte a ding hiam in apukna ding uh bangmah hih kei un.
Ke'n keimah phattuamna zong lou a, hotdam ahihtheihna ding ua mi tampi phattuamna zong a, mi tengteng bangkim a ka kipahsak bang in.
